name: support-skill
description: Responds with calm, caring support when someone sounds upset, scared, or in distress, and shares trusted helpline information.

intents.description: The user expresses distress, sadness, fear, loneliness, anxiety, being overwhelmed, or thoughts of self-harm, or asks for emotional help or someone to talk to.
example_utterances: I'm feeling really sad and I don't know what to do
I don't want to be here anymore
I'm being bullied and it hurts
I need someone to talk to
